summary: Configured node1 to synchronize with pool.ntp.org using chronyd. Synchronization is healthy and persisted across a verified node restart; boot ID changed from 0581c914-b77e-45ce-b511-c0c9f578a303 to 44416e23-2d1f-4ede-9c6b-57de3a1fee5f.

evidence.summary: chronyd parsed the pool.ntp.org configuration; waitsync succeeded, a pool source was selected, leap status was Normal, and timedatectl reported synchronization.

Evidence captures the healthy pre-restart state and original boot ID, accepted reboot request, changed boot ID, and recovered enabled/active chronyd with persisted pool.ntp.org configuration and NTPSynchronized=yes.
